name: Compute Volume of Binary Nifti images
summary: Computes the volume of each binary tract mask and its proportion of FreeSurfer estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV), saved as JSON.
description: Reads eTIV from the FreeSurfer stats/aseg.stats file, counts non-zero voxels in every *Vol.nii.gz mask in the input directory, multiplies by voxel volume and writes volumes.json (mm^3) and volumes_icvproportion.json (volume/eTIV). Use it to quantify tract volumes normalised for head size.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directory used for eTIV.

inputs.requirements: Only files ending in Vol.nii.gz are measured.

outputs.description: volumes.json (volume per mask in mm^3) and volumes_icvproportion.json (volume divided by eTIV, plus eTIV).
